test_inputs.explanation: The agent navigated to the invoices grid at http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_invoice/ and then directly opened an invoice view at /admin/sales_invoice/view/invoice_id/42/. The only concrete value observed was the invoice entity id 42 (used in the URL), so the inputs leave filters empty, use the default grid id 'sales_invoice_grid', do not perform the PDF mass action, and set open_invoice_view=true to reproduce opening the invoice detail view.
